chief_data.selection_justification: Selected because it meets the flow justification basis with enhanced laminar mixing and achieves a 3.0x residence-time reduction over batch, while maintaining acceptable safety and productivity.
chief_data.selection_rationale: Candidate 1 is selected with a combined score of 0.706, driven by its high safety score (0.920) and adequate performance in kinetics (0.850) and fluidics (0.880). It meets the flow justification basis by achieving the required 3.0x residence-time reduction over batch. Candidate 4, with a combined score of 0.686, was held back by lower safety (0.700) and geometry scores (0.526). The user objective of balanced performance influenced the decision, prioritizing safety and process value. The most important remaining uncertainties are the kinetic enhancement factor and the actual selectivity improvement in flow. The first experiment should verify the residence time and selectivity under flow conditions.
resolved_tradeoffs: id=1 vs id=4: id=1 has higher safety score (0.920 vs 0.700) and better fluidics (0.880 vs 0.850).
remaining_uncertainties: k estimated from batch; flow enhancement factor of 10× is class-typical but not experimentally verified
chief_data.experiment_recommendation: Run blank solvent at design Q for 30 min, then switch to reaction mixture. Sample at t=3τ and t=5τ.
